subject: Startups
title: Android: Cameras to Phones
description: Learn Android: Cameras to Phones in one minute.

hook.text: Android was originally built as an operating system for digital cameras. The phone part came later.

buildup.text: Andy Rubin founded Android Inc. in 2003 to create a smart camera OS with cloud storage and sharing.

discovery.text: The team realized the camera market was too small. Smartphones were growing fast, so they pivoted to phones.

twist.text: Google bought Android in 2005 for $50 million. It seemed like a small bet at the time.

climax.text: Android now runs on 3 billion devices—the most popular OS on Earth. The camera pivot created mobile's backbone.

punchline.text: A camera OS pivoted to phones and conquered the world.

quiz.question: What was Android originally designed for?
